scope: Bounded static review of the download-only collector; no provider call, download, fit, push, or source edit.
findings: The wrapper is download-only, requires the exact root-admitted ERROR status and pinned R4 artifacts, checks the fresh session-output endpoint before download, refuses an existing destination, and delegates one bounded attempt to the reviewed R2 collector.

The R2 collector compares the downloaded filename set and byte sizes with the fresh provider inventory, hashes every downloaded file, and compares the CLI response.log bytes/hash against the fresh session-output response-log metadata. The ERROR path writes terminal-download-complete/science-not-validated diagnostics and does not run strict scientific validation or issue a score.

The pinned pre-download receipt is internally consistent: outer and endpoint inventories each list 108 names, the endpoint inventory is complete, and the endpoint response-log SHA/size is recorded. The focused R4 wrapper tests passed 3/3 under 50% CPU, one thread, 700 MB, and 120 seconds.
blocking_finding: The wrapper validates the pinned pre-download receipt only by schema, kernel, ERROR status, output count, no-download flag, and complete flag. It then gets a fresh session-output inventory and downloads against that fresh inventory without requiring its exact filenames to equal the 108 names in the pinned receipt. A changed 108-file set could therefore be downloaded under an admission reviewed against a different set. Before download, require exact filename-set equality with the pinned receipt (and preserve the fresh inventory receipt).

evidence.test_command: WNN_SLICE=wnn-campaign.slice WNN_CPU_QUOTA=50% WNN_THREADS=1 WNN_MEM_MAX=700000000 WNN_RUNTIME_MAX=120s scripts/limited .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q .../clean_t3_f0_r4_terminal_collection_r1/test_collect_r4_terminal.py

scientific_interpretation: The terminal ERROR is execution evidence only; this review makes no claim that the fit or any model failed scientifically.
